@media(orientation:portrait) and (max-width:600px){
 #hud{padding:7px;gap:2px;align-items:flex-start}

 .task-progress{font-size:10px;color:#ffe873;margin-top:5px}
 .hud-right{gap:2px;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:flex-start}
 .hud-right .icon-btn{width:29px;height:30px;min-width:29px;font-size:16px;border-width:2px}
 .score{height:30px;min-width:60px;font-size:13px;gap:1px;padding:0 5px}
 .score-star{font-size:20px}
 .hud-prompt{top:auto;bottom:166px;left:50%;width:calc(100vw - 32px);max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);font-size:clamp(13px,3.5vw,16px);line-height:1.12;color:#ffe579;text-shadow:0 2px #082044,-1px -1px #082044,1px 1px #082044,0 3px 7px #031629}
 #level-meter{bottom:101px}

.package-top span{font-size:11px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.13em}
.package-top strong{font-size:clamp(17px,2.2vw,28px);color:#25576d}
.package-lines{margin:13px 0;background:#fffdf3;padding:17px;border:2px solid #ab9267;border-radius:12px;min-height:103px}
.package-lines b{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em}
.package-lines p{font-size:clamp(16px,1.8vw,21px);font-weight:900;color:#293c52;margin:9px 0 0;line-height:1.42}
.package-lines.obscured p{filter:blur(5px);user-select:none}
.inspection-note{background:#d6e8df;border-left:6px solid #398b8b;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 13px;line-height:1.35;font-size:clamp(14px,1.5vw,17px);font-weight:850;min-height:71px}
.inspection-note:not(.visible){opacity:.35;filter:blur(3px)}
.inspection-note strong{color:#255a66;display:block;margin-top:5px}
/* Compact help: conversation remains a comic speech balloon over its owner. */
#comic{background:#fdfbfa;max-height:min(53vh,365px);overflow:visible}
#comic .comic-text{font-size:clamp(16px,1.36vw,20px);line-height:1.35}
#comic button{min-height:38px}
/* Simplify gameplay chrome and reserve the center of attention for mechanics. */
#level-meter{bottom:13px;padding:6px 11px;opacity:.90}
@media(max-width:780px){
 .hud-left{max-width:145px}.level-label{font-size:17px}.level-label .level-index{font-size:10px}
 .level-sub,.quest-hint{display:none}.task-progress{font-size:12px;margin-top:5px}
 #hud{padding:8px;gap:3px}.hud-right{gap:4px}
 .hud-right .icon-btn{width:39px;height:40px;font-size:20px;border-width:2px;min-width:39px}
 .score{min-width:65px;padding:0 5px;height:39px;font-size:15px;border-width:2px;gap:1px}
 .score-star{font-size:22px}
 .hud-prompt{top:92px;left:50%;max-width:calc(100vw - 26px);width:max-content;font-size:15px;text-align:center}
 #level-meter{bottom:107px}.level-dot{width:25px;height:25px}
 #touch-controls{bottom:19px}.touch-group{gap:8px}.touch-button{min-width:60px;min-height:61px}
 .touch-button.talk{width:62px;height:64px}.touch-button.jump{width:92px;height:77px;font-size:17px}
 .training{left:10px;bottom:127px;width:calc(100vw - 20px);padding:10px 13px 12px}
 .training strong{font-size:19px}.training p{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:7px}
 .training-rail{height:6px}
 .package-inspector{padding:9px}.package-lines{padding:9px}.package-lines p{font-size:15px}
 .activity-scene{min-height:135px;padding:9px;gap:9px}.activity-progress{margin-bottom:8px;gap:5px}
 .activity-progress span{width:29px;height:29px;font-size:13px}.activity-symbol{font-size:48px}
 .activity-action{font-size:17px}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
 .hud-right .icon-btn{width:38px;height:39px;min-width:38px;font-size:19px}
 .score{height:39px;min-width:62px;font-size:15px}.score-star{font-size:21px}
 .level-label{font-size:15px}.level-label .level-index{font-size:10px}
 .hud-left{max-width:110px}.task-progress{font-size:11px}
 .hud-prompt{font-size:14px;top:97px}
 .touch-button.jump{width:88px;height:74px}
}
.inspection-instruction{color:#41626f;font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,19px);font-weight:950;line-height:1.3;margin:9px 0}
.ingredient-choices{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:6px 0 11px}
.ingredient-chip{background:#fff9df;border:2px solid #4f8e9a;color:#245469;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 14px;font-size:clamp(14px,1.1vw,17px);font-weight:950;box-shadow:0 3px #8c9b92}
.ingredient-chip:hover,.ingredient-chip:focus-visible{background:#c1eeea}
.ingredient-chip.not-evidence{background:#f0d4d4;border-color:#b67d78}
#activity-feedback{font-weight:900;color:#ffda8a;text-align:center;min-height:17px;font-size:14px;margin-top:10px}
.pill-button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;filter:grayscale(.55)}
.workshop-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:12px}
.workshop-item{background:#294983;border:2px solid #9bbfea;border-radius:17px;color:#eff7ff;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:141px}
.workshop-item strong{font-size:15px;line-height:1.13}.workshop-item small{font-size:12px;color:#ffe38d;font-weight:900}
.workshop-item.locked{filter:grayscale(.7);opacity:.6}.scarf-preview{width:62px;height:20px;border:3px solid #fff9c6;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #1c3060}
.replay-badges{text-align:center;color:#ffe99d!important;font-size:17px!important}
@media(max-width:700px){.workshop-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.workshop-item{min-height:94px;padding:7px}.workshop-item strong{font-size:13px}}

@media(max-width:780px){.training{bottom:160px}}

/* Production interaction pass: real workbench, objects, and physically meaningful state.
   Crisp equipment slots and a subdued background keep the interactive layer dominant. */
.station-activity{display:block;min-height:0;max-width:890px;margin:auto;padding:clamp(12px,2vw,22px);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#142c5d,#213e6b 65%,#315b6b);border:3px solid #80d8da;border-radius:23px;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 14px #040e2d99,0 9px 0 #0a1b46}
.station-header strong{display:block;color:#ffe78d;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-shadow:0 3px #0b1f48}
.station-header p{color:#d7f5f5;font-size:clamp(13px,1.2vw,17px);line-height:1.36;margin:8px 0 12px}
.station-workbench{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.03fr 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:stretch}
.station-inventory,.station-board{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#244977e9,#16315eee);border:2px solid #709cb7;border-radius:17px;padding:12px;min-width:0}
.station-caption{display:block;color:#b8f4ff;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:1000;margin-bottom:9px}
.station-pieces{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.station-piece{border:2px solid #88a8c9;border-bottom-width:4px;background:linear-gradient(153deg,#4376a2,#235383);border-radius:13px;min-height:88px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;padding:8px 7px;color:#f4f9f8;font:900 12px/1.17 var(--font);text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #153052;cursor:grab}
.station-piece-icon{font-size:30px;line-height:1.08;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px #0b375e88)}
.station-piece small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#e6ffb5}
.station-piece.selected{border-color:#ffe67e;background:linear-gradient(#6a91c4,#446bb9);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ffe57d99,0 4px 0 #253c6a;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.station-piece.used{opacity:.42;cursor:default;filter:grayscale(.7)}
.station-zones{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-height:calc(100% - 28px)}
.station-zone{border:2px dashed #a6d7de;background:linear-gradient(#26557e,#183a66);border-radius:13px;min-height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;color:#fff9d0;padding:8px 12px;font:900 13px/1.19 var(--font);text-align:left}
.station-zone>span{font-size:24px;flex:none}.station-zone>strong{flex:1}.station-zone>small{font-size:9px;color:#a8e7ed;letter-spacing:.07em}
.station-zone.current{border-color:#ffe16d;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffe16d55;background:linear-gradient(#346b8c,#2b5877)}
.station-zone.filled{border:2px solid #88eccb;background:linear-gradient(#306d70,#1a5459);color:#d9fff3}
.station-zone:disabled{opacity:.92;cursor:default}.station-zone:focus-visible,.station-piece:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #ffe870;outline-offset:3px}
.station-rhythm{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0 12px}
.station-rhythm>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:57px;height:58px;border-radius:15px;background:#294c73;border:3px solid #6887a9;font-size:30px;opacity:.68}
.station-rhythm>span.current{background:#b88e43;border-color:#fff3ad;opacity:1;box-shadow:0 3px 15px #fff3ad55}.station-rhythm>span.lit{background:#2e8573;border-color:#9dffbe;opacity:1}
.station-secondary{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.35;color:#d8eef7!important;margin:9px 0!important}
.station-hunt-scene{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:16px 0}.station-hunt-find{display:grid;place-items:center;width:57px;height:55px;font-size:30px;background:#1c416e;border:2px solid #739dcb;border-radius:13px}
.station-counter{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding-top:13px;color:#c8f4f5;font-size:12px}
.station-counter>span{display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;width:24px;height:24px;background:#344b74;border:2px solid #8197be;font-size:12px}
.station-counter>span.filled{background:#2caa82;border-color:#c7ffda;color:#fff}
.station-counter>strong{margin-left:7px}
#activity-feedback{min-height:24px!important;padding-top:8px!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1.2vw,16px)!important;color:#ffd3a8!important;text-align:center}
#activity-feedback.success{color:#99ffd3!important}
.station-activity.station-art .station-zone{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#6b568c,#4c507d);border-color:#cbb0f6}
.station-activity.station-art .station-zone.filled{background:#536a7f;border-color:#a2f0d4}
.station-activity.station-rhythm .station-pieces{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.station-activity.station-hunt .station-piece{min-height:100px}
.station-activity.station-hunt .station-pieces{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media(max-width:760px){.station-activity{padding:10px}.station-workbench{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px}.station-pieces{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}.station-piece{min-height:66px;padding:5px;font-size:10px}.station-piece-icon{font-size:23px}.station-inventory,.station-board{padding:8px}.station-zones{min-height:0;gap:5px}.station-zone{min-height:47px;padding:6px;font-size:11px}.station-zone>span{font-size:21px}.station-caption{font-size:10px;margin-bottom:5px}.station-header strong{font-size:18px}.station-header p{font-size:12px;margin:5px 0 8px}.station-counter{padding-top:6px}.station-activity.station-hunt .station-piece{min-height:62px}}
@media(max-height:720px){.station-activity{padding:10px}.station-piece{min-height:60px}.station-header p{font-size:12px;margin:4px 0 7px}.station-zone{min-height:45px}.station-inventory,.station-board{padding:7px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.station-piece{transition:none;transform:none!important}}

/* Production station presentation: compact by default; actions remain reachable on phones. */
.panel:has(.station-activity){width:min(925px,96vw);padding:clamp(12px,1.8vw,22px);overflow:auto}
.panel:has(.station-activity)>h2{font-size:clamp(23px,2.65vw,39px);line-height:1.06;margin:4px 0 7px;-webkit-text-stroke:.5px #7e4c36}
.panel:has(.station-activity)>p{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,15px);line-height:1.34;margin:0 0 10px}
.panel:has(.station-activity) .panel-buttons{position:sticky;z-index:6;bottom:-3px;margin-top:9px;padding:12px 4px 5px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#2d3979 24%,#322f75 100%)}
.panel:has(.station-activity) .pill-button{min-height:46px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:clamp(13px,1.25vw,18px)}
.station-activity .station-header strong{font-size:clamp(18px,1.6vw,22px)}
.station-activity .station-header p{font-size:clamp(13px,1vw,15px)}
@media(max-width:780px){
 .panel:has(.station-activity){max-height:92dvh;padding:10px;max-width:96vw}
 .panel:has(.station-activity)>h2{font-size:clamp(21px,4.7vw,26px);margin:3px 0}
 .panel:has(.station-activity)>.panel-kicker{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em}
 .panel:has(.station-activity)>p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:6px}
 .station-activity .station-header strong{display:none}
 .station-activity .station-header p{font-size:12px;margin:1px 0 7px}
 .panel:has(.station-activity) .pill-button{min-height:42px;padding:8px 11px;font-size:13px}
}
/* Critical stacking fix: settings, character selector, workshop and daily panels
   were behind the approved home art (z=80). Keep overlays above every screen. */
#overlay.overlay:not(.hidden){z-index:115}

/* Final production readability pass: larger targets, actual text hierarchy on phones.
   The station panel scrolls internally while its completion actions remain reachable. */
@media(max-width:560px){
 .station-activity .station-header p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.36}
 .station-activity .station-caption{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em}
 .station-activity .station-pieces{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}
 .station-activity .station-piece{font-size:12px;line-height:1.22;min-height:69px;padding:6px 7px}
 .station-activity .station-piece-icon{font-size:27px}
 .station-activity .station-zone{font-size:12px;line-height:1.25;min-height:55px;gap:7px}
 .station-activity .station-zone>small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em}
 .panel:has(.station-activity) .panel-buttons{padding-top:9px}
 .station-activity.station-rhythm .station-pieces,.station-activity.station-hunt .station-pieces{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
}

/* The two mobile station actions share one row, preserving visible progress. */
@media(max-width:560px){
 .panel:has(.station-activity) .panel-buttons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;position:sticky;bottom:-2px;padding:8px 2px 4px;margin:7px 0 0}
 .panel:has(.station-activity) .panel-buttons .pill-button{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:9px 4px;font-size:12px;white-space:normal;line-height:1.17}
 .station-counter{padding-bottom:7px}
}
/* UI / locomotion stabilization: final overrides, safe mobile and landscape layout. */
#hud{padding:12px 16px;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}.hud-left{max-width:30%;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #112747,0 4px 8px #112747}.level-label{font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,25px)}.quest-hint{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,16px);margin-top:6px}.task-progress{font-size:13px}.hud-right{flex-shrink:0;gap:7px}.hud-right .icon-btn{width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;border-width:2px;box-shadow:0 3px 5px #08183999}.score{height:44px;min-width:76px;padding:0 9px;gap:4px;box-shadow:0 3px 5px #08183999}.hud-prompt{max-width:min(44vw,480px);width:max-content;top:80px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.25;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.hud-prompt:empty{display:none}
#comic{max-height:calc(100dvh - 52px);max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);overflow:auto;border-width:3px;border-radius:21px;box-shadow:3px 4px 0 #273447,0 7px 18px #11284b55;padding:12px 15px}#comic .comic-actions{display:grid;gap:7px}#comic button{min-height:44px;text-align:left;white-space:normal}#comic.quick .comic-actions{display:flex}#comic.quick{overflow:visible}#comic:not(.quick)::before,#comic:not(.quick)::after{display:none}
.overlay{padding:12px;align-items:center;overflow:auto;background:#10223cdd;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}.panel{max-height:calc(100dvh - 28px);width:min(880px,100%);border:2px solid #79a7ce;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#173c5f,#26365d);box-shadow:0 10px 30px #081a36b0;padding:clamp(14px,2.2vw,28px);scrollbar-width:thin;overflow:auto}.panel h2{font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,40px);line-height:1.13;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-shadow:none;-webkit-text-stroke:0}.panel>p{line-height:1.45}.panel-buttons{gap:9px;margin-top:16px}.pill-button{min-height:44px;border-radius:13px;white-space:normal;line-height:1.2}.panel:has(.station-activity) .panel-buttons{position:static;background:none;padding:0;margin:14px 0 0}.station-activity{border:1px solid #729eaf;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:none}.station-piece,.station-zone{min-height:48px}.crew-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:18px 0}.crew-choice{background:#233f67;border:2px solid #6f96b8;border-radius:16px;color:white;min-width:0;padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800}.crew-choice[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#ffe36b;background:#3c5b78;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffe36b55}.crew-portrait{width:100%;height:clamp(88px,18vh,160px);object-fit:contain}.map-cards{max-height:none;overflow:visible;margin:18px 0;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(160px,100%),1fr));padding:0}.map-card{min-height:250px}.map-card-image{min-height:108px}.map-top{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.map-actions{flex-wrap:wrap}.map-footer{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px}.map-progress{min-width:120px}.map-card-copy h3{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.hint-controls{opacity:.7}#touch-controls.large .touch-button{min-width:66px;min-height:66px}#touch-controls{transform:none!important}.level-dot.available{background:#385b7b;color:#fff}.training{max-width:calc(100% - 24px);width:min(330px,calc(100% - 24px));border-width:2px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 5px 15px #10214188}.training-top button{width:36px;height:36px}.end-stars{white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:780px){#hud{padding:9px;gap:5px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto}.hud-left{max-width:none;min-width:0}.hud-right{gap:4px}.hud-right .icon-btn{width:36px;height:40px;min-width:36px;font-size:20px}.score{min-width:59px;height:40px;font-size:14px;padding:0 5px}.score-star{font-size:20px}.hud-prompt{top:84px;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);font-size:14px}.level-label{font-size:16px}.level-label .level-index{font-size:10px}.task-progress{font-size:12px}.crew-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.crew-portrait{height:100px}.map-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.map-card{min-height:215px}.map-card-copy{padding:10px;gap:5px}.map-card-copy h3{font-size:17px}.map-top .map-explainer{font-size:14px}.training{bottom:145px;left:12px}.training p{font-size:14px}.panel:has(.station-activity) .panel-buttons{position:static;background:none}.panel:has(.station-activity) .panel-buttons .pill-button{font-size:14px;min-height:44px}}
@media(max-width:360px){.hud-right .icon-btn{width:32px;min-width:32px;height:38px}.hud-right{gap:3px}.score{min-width:52px}.level-label{font-size:14px}.touch-group{gap:5px}.touch-button{width:52px;min-width:52px}.touch-button.jump{width:76px;min-width:76px}.touch-button.talk{width:52px;min-width:52px}}
@media(max-height:480px) and (orientation:landscape){.training{bottom:60px;max-width:270px}.training strong{font-size:17px}.training p{font-size:12px}.hud-prompt{top:60px}.crew-portrait{height:75px}.panel{max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px)}.map-card{min-height:180px}.map-card-image{min-height:80px}}
</style></head><body><main id="game">
<canvas id="scene" aria-label="Welcome Street side-scrolling adventure"></canvas>
<section id="home" aria-label="Ally Quest home"><div id="home-stage"><button id="home-play" class="home-hotspot home-play" aria-label="Play Welcome Street">Play</button><button id="home-map" class="home-hotspot home-map" aria-label="Open level map">Map</button><button id="home-crew" class="home-hotspot home-crew" aria-label="Choose a crew member">My Crew</button><button id="home-workshop" class="home-hotspot home-workshop" aria-label="Workshop">Workshop</button><button id="home-daily" class="home-hotspot home-daily" aria-label="Daily Discovery">Daily</button><button id="home-settings" class="home-hotspot home-settings" aria-label="Settings">Settings</button></div></section>
<section id="map" class="hidden" aria-label="Welcome Street level select"><div class="map-top"><div><span class="map-kicker">WORLD 1 / ALLY QUEST</span><h1 class="map-title">WELCOME STREET ★</h1><p class="map-explainer">Five different adventures. One big celebration. Every friend belongs.</p></div><div class="map-actions"><span class="score"><span class="score-star">★</span><span id="map-stars">0</span></span><button id="map-crew" class="icon-btn" aria-label="Choose hero">♟</button><button id="map-settings" class="icon-btn settings" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button><button id="map-back" class="map-back">← HOME</button></div></div><div id="map-cards" class="map-cards"></div><div class="map-footer"><span id="map-count">0 / 5 adventures completed</span><div class="map-progress"><div id="map-bar-fill"></div></div></div></section>
<div id="hud" class="hidden" role="region" aria-label="Game HUD"><div class="hud-left"><div class="level-label"><span id="hud-number" class="level-index"></span><span id="hud-level"></span></div><div id="hud-subtitle" class="level-sub"></div><div class="quest-hint" id="goal-text"></div><div class="task-progress" id="goal-progress"></div></div><div id="hud-prompt" class="hud-prompt" aria-live="polite"></div><div class="hud-right"><div class="score"><span class="score-star" aria-label="Stars">★</span><span id="hud-score">0 / 5</span></div><button id="settings-button" class="icon-btn settings" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button><button id="sound-button" class="icon-btn music" aria-label="Toggle music and sounds">♫</button><button id="help-button" class="icon-btn help" aria-label="Interactive help">?</button><button id="pause-button" class="icon-btn paused" aria-label="Pause">Ⅱ</button></div></div>
<div id="level-meter" class="hidden" aria-label="Five level progression"></div><div id="training" class="training hidden" role="status" aria-live="polite"><div class="training-top"><span id="training-stage">ALLY ACADEMY 1/5</span><button id="training-dismiss" aria-label="Dismiss training" type="button">✕</button></div><strong id="training-title">LEARN BY PLAYING</strong><p id="training-copy">Walk right to begin.</p><div class="training-rail"><div id="training-meter"></div></div></div><div id="hint-controls" class="hint-controls">← → Move · SPACE Jump · E Talk / Interact · R Restart · P Pause</div>
<div id="touch-controls" class="hidden" aria-label="Touch controls"><div class="touch-group"><button class="touch-button" data-control="left" aria-label="Move left">◀</button><button class="touch-button" data-control="right" aria-label="Move right">▶</button></div><div class="touch-group"><button class="touch-button talk" data-control="talk" aria-label="Talk or interact">E</button><button class="touch-button jump" data-control="jump" aria-label="Jump">JUMP ↟</button></div></div>
<aside id="comic" class="hidden" aria-label="Speech bubble" aria-live="polite"><div id="comic-speaker" class="speaker"></div><p id="comic-text" class="comic-text"></p><div id="comic-actions" class="comic-actions"></div></aside><div id="overlay" class="overlay hidden" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"></div>
